name: Base44
summary: No-code AI builder that turns text descriptions into apps, websites and agents.
description: Base44 lets users build apps, websites, games, internal tools and AI agents by describing them in plain language. The platform includes hosting, a database, authentication and integrations, so no separate setup is required. Users can start for free; paid plans are based on message and integration credits and start at $40 per month billed annually, with higher tiers at $80 and $160 per month.
